description: Election Commission - Notice of filling a vacancy, appointing Mr. K. Y. P. Ram to the Western Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Western Province Provincial Council due to a resignation. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new member, which falls under electoral processes and candidate registrations as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). The content involves the Election Commission's actions under the Provincial Councils Elections Act, which is directly related to electoral matters rather than general government personnel changes or structural adjustments.
